<content>
1: // Pixel Dodger – simple canvas game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Player
11:   const player = { w: 40, h: 20, x: width / 2 - 20, y: height - 30, speed: 5 };
12: 
13:   // Blocks
14:   const blocks = [];
15:   let blockSpawnTimer = 0;
16:   let blockSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
17:   let blockSpeed = 2;
18:   let lastTime = 0;
19:   let score = 0;
20:   let gameOver = false;
21: 
22:   // Helper: draw rounded rectangle
23:   function drawRoundedRect(x, y, w, h, radius, fillStyle) {
24:     ctx.beginPath();
25:     ctx.moveTo(x + radius, y);
26:     ctx.lineTo(x + w - radius, y);
27:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + radius);
28:     ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - radius);
29:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - radius, y + h);
30:     ctx.lineTo(x + radius, y + h);
31:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - radius);
32:     ctx.lineTo(x, y + radius);
33:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + radius, y);
34:     ctx.closePath();
35:     ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle;
36:     ctx.fill();
37:   }
38: 
39:   // Helper: background gradient
40:   function drawBackground() {
41:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
42:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001d3d');
43:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#003566');
44:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
45:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
46:   }
47: 
48:   // Sound setup using Web Audio API
49:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
50:   // Ensure audio context is resumed on first user interaction
51:   function ensureAudioContext() {
52:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
53:   }
54:   window.addEventListener('keydown', ensureAudioContext);
55: 
56:   function playBeep(freq, duration) {
57:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
58:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
59:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
60:     osc.type = 'sine';
61:     osc.connect(gain);
62:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
63:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
64:     osc.start();
65:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
66:   }
67: 
68:   // Input
69:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
70:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
71: 
72:   function spawnBlock() {
73:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
74:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size);
75:     blocks.push({ x, y: -size, w: size, h: size });
76:     // Play a short beep when a block appears
77:     playBeep(300, 100);
78:   }
79: 
80:   function update(dt) {
81:     // player movement
82:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.x -= player.speed;
83:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.x += player.speed;
84:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - player.w, player.x));
85: 
86:     // spawn blocks
87:     blockSpawnTimer += dt;
88:     if (blockSpawnTimer > blockSpawnInterval) {
89:       spawnBlock();
90:       blockSpawnTimer = 0;
91:     }
92: 
93:     // update blocks
94:     for (let i = blocks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
95:       const b = blocks[i];
96:       b.y += blockSpeed * (dt / 16.67);
97:       // collision
98:         if (
99:           b.x < player.x + player.w &&
100:           b.x + b.w > player.x &&
101:           b.y < player.y + player.h &&
102:           b.y + b.h > player.y
103:         ) {
104:           gameOver = true;
105:           // Play collision sound
106:           playBeep(150, 300);
107:         }
108:       // remove off‑screen
109:       if (b.y > height) blocks.splice(i, 1);
110:     }
111: 
112:     // increase difficulty over time
113:     blockSpeed += dt * 0.00001; // gradual acceleration
114:     blockSpawnInterval = Math.max(300, blockSpawnInterval - dt * 0.01);
115:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000);
116:   }
117: 
118:   function draw() {
119:     // background gradient
120:     drawBackground();
121:     // player (rounded green)
122:     drawRoundedRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h, 5, '#00ff88');
123:     // blocks (rounded red)
124:     blocks.forEach(b => drawRoundedRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4, '#ff5555'));
125:     // score
126:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
127:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
128:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
129:     if (gameOver) {
130:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
131:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
132:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
133:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
134:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 80, height / 2);
135:     }
136:   }
137: 
138:   function loop(timestamp) {
139:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
140:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
141:     lastTime = timestamp;
142:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
143:     draw();
144:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
145:   }
146: 
147:   const startTime = performance.now();
148:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
149: })();

(End of file - total 149 lines)
</content>
